svg.title: The loop belongs to the application
svg.desc: A four-position indexing table with a guarded stop lever. A model proposes the next step. Application code controls authority, state, budgets, and when the loop stops.
svg.text: The loop belongs to the application
Read the goal, constraints, and current state before proposing another action.
The model proposes one bounded next step. A proposal grants no permission.
Application code validates and authorizes the tool call before it executes.
